findings.message: 6 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Websites & systems that bring you more customers" → 3 lines (8 words, 62.4px); "Same company. A completely different website." → 3 lines (6 words, 48px); "Websites, and the systems behind them." → 3 lines (6 words, 48px); "Transparent packages. No retainers." → 3 lines (4 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Accepting New Projects" (pill) above "Websites & systems that bring you more c"; "Most Popular" (pill) above "Rs. 55,000"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. ".com", ".lk", "enerfab.lk", "englishgenius.lk"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01.", "02.", "03.", "04."
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: 🌍
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 6 gradient fill(s): div.build-col → radial-gradient(120% 70% at 0% 0%, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.16), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%), none | div.build-col → radial-gradient(120% 70% at 0% 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.18), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%), none | div.build-col → radial-gradient(120% 70% at 0% 0%, rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.15), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%), none
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 22 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.primary → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.8) 0px 12p | a.hero-ba → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) 0px 40px 90px -40px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 0px 0px 0px 1p | span.fchip.fc1 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85) 0px 22px 44px -14px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 17 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header#top.nav 1425px | div.work-frame 427px | div.bf-bar 425px | div.work-frame 427px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 47 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 4 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 3 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (6, 3, 4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Plus Jakarta Sans, Syne, JetBrains Mono).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 32 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 62.4px (4.3vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The margins differ: 145px on the left, 161px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "English Genius" (0px from the left); "cinemoraproduction.com" (15px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Websites & systems that bring you more customers" → 4 lines (8 words, 48.2px); "Same company. A completely different website." → 3 lines (6 words, 36.7px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 9822px of nothing between: section#quote.sec
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.
